verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI search/answer API, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Perplexity-hosted services: the Sonar/Agent API, the hosted open-weight model endpoint, and hosted built-in tools and sandbox. The open-source local MCP server is just a stdio bridge to the hosted API, not a self-hostable core product. Nothing in the pack shows the search or answer engine can be deployed on your own infrastructure.
